verdicts.summary: The branch guard only compares the branch names before and after the read. If the checkout goes A→B→A while the PR lookup runs, B's remote status is cached under branch A.
verdicts.scenario: 1) Cache holds local A. A poller or getStatus calls readRemoteStatus: currentBranch returns A (VcsStatusBroadcaster.ts:381). 2) An agent runs `git checkout B`. GitManager.readRemoteStatus then calls statusDetailsRemote, which resolves branch B (GitManager.ts:1372-1373) and starts a slow gh lookup for B (GitManager.ts:1380-1391). 3) The agent runs `git checkout A` before the lookup returns. 4) The second currentBranch returns A (line 385). branch === currentBranch, so line 390 returns {branch:'A', value: B's PR, ahead/behind}. 5) updateCachedRemoteStatus accepts it because the branch matches local A (line 297) and publishes it. getStatus then serves it from cache (line 345).
verdicts.consequence: The UI shows branch B's PR and B's ahead/behind counts for branch A until the next full refresh or poll. The new guard was meant to rule this out.

verdicts.summary: The localOnly path now reads `previous` (line 487) before it takes the remote lock. When it gets the lock, it acts on that stale snapshot and overwrites a remote status that a lock holder has just loaded with the null 'no PR' marker.
verdicts.scenario: 1) A user opens a project. streamStatus starts the poller with refreshImmediately=true (line 731). refreshRemoteStatus takes the lock and starts a slow gh lookup; the cache holds local A with remote null. 2) The user opens the branch menu, which sends vcsRefreshStatus {localOnly:true} (BranchToolbarBranchSelector.tsx:511). refreshStatus reads previous={local A, remote null} at line 487, publishes local at line 488, then waits for the lock at line 490. 3) The poller finishes, writes remote {branch A, PR #N} and publishes it (line 478), then releases the lock. needsInitialRefresh is set to false (line 591). 4) The localOnly section runs. `!previous?.remote` is true from the stale snapshot (line 493), so it writes the null marker for branch A (lines 495-499). The fingerprint differs, so it publishes remoteUpdated null. 5) getStatus returns the cached null (line 345). refreshPullRequestStatus returns null because value===null (line 533). With interval 0 the poller never reads again (line 566). The same happens when the branch changed before the call and a lock holder already loaded the new branch's remote. Before this change `previous` was read inside the lock, so this could not happen. Finding 0's 'no remote cached yet' case is different: here the remote was cached by the time the lock was taken. For the note's open question: git and VcsProcess default to a 30s timeout (VcsProcess.ts:214). I did not check that every provider's PR call goes through VcsProcess.
verdicts.consequence: The PR badge and ahead/behind counts that just loaded disappear when the user opens the branch menu. They stay gone until a full refresh, or one poll interval if automatic fetch is on (never on its own when the interval is 0).
